pr.title: fix(context): single body overrides other returns

summary: This PR improves type tracking for the `body()` method by adding generic type parameters to the BodyRespond interface to capture status codes, similar to existing `text()` and `json()` methods. The runtime behavior is unchanged; this is purely a type-system enhancement. The implementation uses a safe type cast and includes a test validating that multiple body() calls in different branches correctly produce a union of status codes.
